name: The Inception
source:
Amelia City, year 2356. You play as a bounty hunter, an agent outside the system, who survives day to day with a shitty job. He is involved in a chase he didn't expect, where his past will come to light. Helped by his sister, they will try to escape without looking back, and whatever it takes.

[Edited from F95Zone]
translation:
阿米莉亚城，2356年。你扮演一名赏金猎人，一名体制外的特工，靠着一份糟糕的工作日复一日地生存。他卷入了一场出乎意料的追逐之中，他的过去也随之曝光。在他姐姐的帮助下，他们将不惜一切代价，头也不回地试图逃跑。

[编辑自F95Zone]
